title: At the Kings' Gate
journal: I carry all three seal-stones of the kings' gate. I'm to bring them to Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

plan.going: I have all three stones the ghost at Teku-Sul named; the order wants them
plan.next: report to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom
plan.ways: none; the report is the step

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka. I carry the three seal-stones of the kings gate and the journal says to bring them to Never-Writes-Twice at the back of Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom.
Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom.
I can go to Never-Writes-Twice and hand over the stones, talk to her first to ask questions, or check the journal and inventory. I mean to take the e-believed ending when a choice is offered.
I do not understand how Nesh-Deeka knows the Unbound, what the Eye at the Root is, or why Cuts-the-Old-Knot seals trees. I could find out by talking to people and reading the journal.
